LANTERN VNC · COMMUNITY WIKIPreview documentation

Lantern VNC wiki

Lantern is a free native VNC viewer for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 13 or later. It connects directly to an existing VNC server such as TightVNC. The app has no Lantern account, expiry, subscription, or payment gate.

Guide What it covers
Getting started Open the app, find a local server, name a device, and optionally remember its password.
Display and navigation Fit, saved zoom/picture presets, large desktops, and local versus remote scrolling.
Troubleshooting Connection, authentication, display, and input problems.
FAQ Compatibility, clipboard behavior, privacy, and project limits.

These pages describe the implemented 1.1.0-preview.5, including bounded local-server discovery, opt-in macOS Keychain passwords, and saved viewing preferences per host and port. New endpoints start in Fit with the Wi-Fi high-quality preset. Preview 5 reduces local copying for small screen changes and services queued input during partial updates; it does not change picture quality or VNC network compression. It is a preview, not a stable-release claim: physical external-display transitions and the complete manual hardware matrix remain unverified. See the changelog and release checklist; unchecked cases are not passes.

Feedback and contributions

Search existing issues or open a bug report or feature request. Include the app version and reproducible steps. For a display issue, include the remote resolution, local window size, display scale, and selected viewing mode.

Issues are public. Remove passwords, private server addresses, clipboard contents, and personal desktop information before sharing notes or screenshots. The app's Help → Save Feedback… command writes a local file; it does not submit that file automatically.

See Contributing, the code of conduct, and security policy.
